David thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the work station. Anna is interested in singing. Best of all, the conditional offer requires a B in maths.

David usually has dumplings for breakfast. David is going to travel to Rome in September. Anna's birthday is in September. What's more, she received an unconditional offer in May.
